product_constraint: 1.5x–3x same-workload committed Decode at d2/d3, exact target state/logits/output, paired Prefill/TTFT/Decode/total.
question: In unchanged M3 canonical FP8 GDN QKV, does DRAM/operand delivery or instruction/shared-table issue limit the exact verifier? Do not infer a global hardware bound.
scope: Checkpoint-weight-only component attribution, deterministic BF16 activations; no data-dependent skipping. Not real-prompt activation or whole-model timing.

selection.criterion: Ascending entropy of all48real FP8 code histograms; fixed ranks0,23,35,47 before timing

protocol: T2 unchanged-kernel four-layer rotation then one T4 capture of median layer after same four-layer warmup; preflight/cache preparation per process, 8GiB reserve and >90C stop. No clock/fan control. Stop on resource/ownership or tool failure without replay variations.
exit: Record causal evidence or unsupported counters, then select a bounded computation/dataflow change or reject a proposed mechanism; no further counter campaign. Exact original source and output hashes bind probe.
